name: Triumph
notes: Gains an Estate and awards VP based on cards gained this turn, conditional on successfully gaining the Estate.

name: Annex
notes: Returns most discarded cards to the deck and gains a Duchy.

name: Donate
notes: After turn, may trash any number from collected deck/hand.

name: Advance
notes: Optionally trashes an Action from hand to gain an eligible Action.

name: Delve
notes: Provides an additional Buy and gains a Silver.

name: Tax
notes: Adds Debt tokens to supply pile.

name: Banquet
notes: Gains two Coppers and a non-Victory card within a cost limit.

name: Ritual
notes: Gains a Curse; if successful, trashes from hand and scores VP according to the trashed card cost.

name: Salt the Earth
notes: Trashes a Victory card from Supply.

name: Wedding
notes: Gives VP and gains a Gold.

name: Windfall
notes: Gain Golds if deck and discard are empty.

name: Conquest
notes: Gains Silvers and scores VP according to Silvers gained this turn.

name: Dominate
notes: Gains a Province and awards VP if the gain succeeds.

name: Aqueduct
notes: Moves VP tokens onto Aqueduct upon Treasure gain; Victory gain claims tokens.

name: Arena
notes: Optional Action discard at Buy start for VP tokens.

name: Bandit Fort
notes: Penalizes owning Silver and Gold at endgame.

name: Basilica
notes: VP when buying with enough coins left.

name: Baths
notes: VP if turn ends with no cards gained.

name: Battlefield
notes: VP when gaining Victory card.

name: Colonnade
notes: VP pool reward for buying an Action with a copy already in play.

name: Defiled Shrine
notes: Moves VP tokens off Action piles on gain; buying a Curse claims accumulated VP.

name: Fountain
notes: Scoring bonus for required number of Coppers.

name: Keep
notes: Scores for Treasure names where the player holds a tied or outright maximum number.

name: Labyrinth
notes: Awards VP from its pool when a second card is gained during a turn.

name: Mountain Pass
notes: Runs a one-time auction after the first Province is gained; winner takes Debt and VP.

name: Museum
notes: Awards points for the number of differently named cards owned.

name: Obelisk
notes: Selects an Action Supply pile at setup and awards points for cards owned from that pile.

name: Orchard
notes: Scores distinct Action names owned in groups of at least three.

name: Palace
notes: Scores complete Copper, Silver, Gold sets.

name: Tomb
notes: Awards VP each time a player trashes a card.

name: Tower
notes: Scores non-Victory cards from empty Supply piles.

name: Triumphal Arch
notes: Scores copies of a player’s second-most-common Action name, under tie rules.

name: Wall
notes: Penalizes cards owned beyond the first fifteen.

name: Wolf Den
notes: Penalizes card names owned in exactly one copy.

name: Delay
notes: Set aside Action from hand and play next turn

name: Desperation
notes: Gain Curse for a once-per-turn Buy and coin benefit

name: Gamble
notes: Reveal top card; optionally play it if Action or Treasure

name: Pursue
notes: Name card; keep named cards on deck and discard other reveals

name: Ride
notes: Gain a Horse

name: Toil
notes: Play Action from hand without using an Action

name: Enhance
notes: Trash from hand and gain a more expensive card

name: March
notes: Play Action from discard pile

name: Transport
notes: Exile Action from Supply or move own Exiled Action onto deck

name: Banish
notes: Exile any number of copies of a single card name from hand

name: Bargain
notes: Gain a non-Victory card, opponents gain Horses

name: Invest
notes: Exile a Supply Action; draw when opponents gain/invest copies

name: Seize the Day
notes: Take an extra turn once per game

name: Commerce
notes: Gain Golds per distinct gained card name this turn

name: Demand
notes: Gain Horse and another eligible card onto deck

name: Stampede
notes: Gain five Horses onto deck if sufficiently few cards in play

name: Reap
notes: Gain Gold set aside to be played next turn

name: Enclave
notes: Gain Gold; Exile Duchy from Supply

name: Alliance
notes: Gain specified cards from Supply

name: Populate
notes: Gain from each Action Supply pile

name: Way of the Butterfly
notes: Return played Action to Supply, gain card costing exactly one more

name: Way of the Camel
notes: Exile Gold from Supply

name: Way of the Chameleon
notes: Switch +Cards and +Coins effects for that play

name: Way of the Frog
notes: Topdeck played Action at cleanup

name: Way of the Goat
notes: Trash card from hand

name: Way of the Horse
notes: Draw two, +Action, return played Action to Supply

name: Way of the Mole
notes: Discard hand; draw three and +Action

name: Way of the Monkey
notes: +Buy and +Coins

name: Way of the Mouse
notes: Play preset Action chosen during setup

name: Way of the Mule
notes: +Action and +Coin

name: Way of the Otter
notes: Draw two

name: Way of the Owl
notes: Draw until six cards in hand

name: Way of the Ox
notes: +2 Actions

name: Way of the Pig
notes: +Card and +Action

name: Way of the Rat
notes: Discard Treasure to gain copy of played Action

name: Way of the Seal
notes: +Coin and may topdeck cards gained this turn

name: Way of the Sheep
notes: +2 Coins

name: Way of the Squirrel
notes: Draw two at end of turn

name: Way of the Turtle
notes: Set aside played Action and play next turn

name: Way of the Worm
notes: Exile Estate from Supply

name: Bury
notes: Put card from discard on bottom of deck

name: Avoid
notes: Exclude up to three cards from next shuffle this turn

name: Deliver
notes: Set aside gained cards; move to hand at end of turn

name: Peril
notes: Optional trash Action from hand to gain Loot

name: Rush
notes: Next Action gained this turn is played

name: Foray
notes: Discard three differently named cards to gain Loot

name: Launch
notes: Return to Action phase, +Card, +Action, +Buy

name: Mirror
notes: Next Action gained this turn is copied

name: Prepare
notes: Set aside hand to play Action/Treasure cards next turn

name: Scrounge
notes: Choose trash from hand or gain Estate from Trash and extra card

name: Journey
notes: Take extra turn without discarding cards from play

name: Maelstrom
notes: Trash three from hand; opponents with 5+ cards trash one

name: Looting
notes: Gain Loot

name: Invasion
notes: Play Attack optionally; gain Duchy, topdeck Action, gain/play Loot

name: Prosper
notes: Gain Loot and any number of differently named Treasures

name: Cheap
notes: The chosen Kingdom pile costs less

name: Cursed
notes: Gain Loot and Curse when gaining card from affected pile

name: Fated
notes: Position affected cards top or bottom during shuffle

name: Fawning
notes: Gain affected card when gaining Province

name: Friendly
notes: Discard Friendly card on turn to gain qualifying cheaper card

name: Hasty
notes: Set aside gained affected card and play at start of next turn

name: Inherited
notes: Replace starting card with card from selected pile

name: Inspiring
notes: After playing affected card, may play different Action

name: Nearby
notes: Gaining affected card yields +Buy

name: Patient
notes: Set aside affected card from hand to play next turn

name: Pious
notes: May trash a card from hand when gaining affected card

name: Reckless
notes: Repeat instructions when played; return from play to Supply

name: Rich
notes: Gain Silver when gaining affected card

name: Shy
notes: Discard affected card from hand to draw cards

name: Tireless
notes: Topdeck affected card when discarded from play
